Rokt is hiring a Junior Software Engineer for its 18-week, full-time Rokt Residency in New York City. Residents build and deploy production services and features on an engineering team, using AI tools and automation while improving systems and delivering measurable contributions.

Responsibilities
Build and deploy production services and features on a Rokt engineering team, from prototype through to release
Use AI tools and automation to speed up coding, testing, and deployment
Find performance bottlenecks and use data to improve systems that run at the scale of billions of transactions
Work with product managers, designers, and senior Builders to ship features that drive revenue for Rokt and its partners
Deliver measurable contribution to your team by the end of the Residency

Required
Software engineering experience, including internships, personal projects, open-source work, or hackathons
Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and how to write clean, tested code
Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Go, TypeScript, Java, or C#
Evidence that you have built and shipped something real, such as a project, product, or tool that other people use
Hands-on experience using AI coding tools to build software
Ability to work in fast-paced teams
Constantly looking for new ways to improve and accelerate a function
Benefits
Enterprise access to leading AI tools with generous usage limits from day one.
Catered lunch every day and a fully stocked pantry.
Dog-friendly offices so you can bring your best friend to work.
Generous technology allowance to spend on a Macbook Pro M5 + accessories; yours to keep after the residency.
For permanent employment: fully funded Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance.
For permanent employment: dollar-for-dollar 401K matching plan, up to 4% of fixed annual salary.
For permanent employment: fully funded life, short term, and long term disability insurance.
For permanent employment: equity in a profitable, fast-growing company approaching $1 Billion in revenue.
For permanent employment: monthly Wellness and Cell Phone Allowances.
For permanent employment: quarterly performance reviews for most roles, so feedback and promotion decisions don’t wait.
For permanent employment: extra leave (bonus annual leave, sabbatical leave etc.).
